study: Stage 1 of the paid-data decision: does the SIP volume breakout clear its costs on tight-spread names out of period? If yes, real-time SIP is worth buying; if no, it is not (for this signal family).
registered_at: 2026-10-03, before any data for this study was fetched
origin: wr_trigger_study 9/16-9/25 (SIP 1m, $20-100): volume > 3x 20-min mean + close > 15-min high, fwd15 +9.4 bp gross (t 3.1); on IEX ~0; on the paper book net negative because bursts carried 23-34 bp spreads. Those days are excluded here.

data.universe: per day d, from the all-symbol daily panel (ai_reports/allsym/daily_2025-09-01_2026-10-02.pkl): common stock with open >= $10, prior-day dollar volume >= $20M, gap open/prior close - 1 >= +2%; at most the 150 largest gaps per day
data.period: 2026-04-01..2026-09-12 (held out; ends before the 9/16-9/25 discovery window)
data.bars: Alpaca SIP 1-minute RTH bars (open, high, close, volume), split-adjusted
data.quotes: Alpaca SIP NBBO at each entry time (historical, free once 15 min old)

definitions.signal: minute t in 09:45..15:30 where volume(t) > 3 x mean volume of the 20 prior minutes AND close(t) > max high of the 15 prior minutes; at most one per name per 15 minutes
definitions.entry: open of bar t+1 (the next minute)
definitions.exit: close of the bar 15 minutes after entry (also 30, reported), capped at 15:55
definitions.cost: the full SIP quoted spread at the entry time, charged once per round trip (half in, half out), as in the strategy-edge studies
definitions.capped: the subset whose SIP spread at entry <= 5 bp (the desk's live cap since 10/3)
definitions.control: 5 random entry minutes per signal in the same name-day (09:45..15:30), same horizon, same spread rule (capped controls must also be <= 5 bp)
definitions.quiet_tape: secondary filter (real-time SIP only): exclude signals whose last 5 closed minutes' volume < 0.25 x the session's per-minute pace so far

split: by date, first half / second half
statistic: mean net bp per signal, t clustered by day
pass: CAPPED arm: net15 >= +5 bp with day-clustered t >= 2 in BOTH halves, n >= 100 per half, AND net15 above the capped random control in both halves. Gross, net30, the uncapped arm and the quiet-tape-filtered arm are reported but do not gate.
if_pass: the evidence to buy real-time SIP: then a live A/B of the breakout trigger on SIP vs the IEX desk
if_fail: real-time SIP is not worth buying for this signal family; stage 2 (order-book depth sample) is the remaining paid-data question
note: premarket is not retested: premarket_burst study already found premarket spikes fade like RTH on SIP history
